name: Observe the field
summary: Observe a persistent field of sites without changing it.
description: Returns all sites with coordinates, water, activity and held drive, plus the current simulation tick. Repeated observations do not change the field. There are no tasks, scores or rewards. The field is 6 by 6; coordinates run from 0 to 5. The complete state belongs to the supervisor and cannot be rewritten by workspace programs. Configuration must enable the phenomena service. No filesystem, network or other host permission is granted.

demonstrations.title: Try world.observe
demonstrations.explanation: Runs the real supervisor-owned field when configured; changing controls or advancing has persistent effects. Builder self-tests inject an unavailable fake (available=false), never a simulated observation.

limitations: Requires frozen experiment phenomena configuration; disabled services are hidden from discovery.
This is an abstract, bounded simulation, not a validated model of a physical or biological system.
Private state follows complete-step checkpoints; crash recovery may roll back later effects while retaining their observations.

failure_modes.condition: Service not configured, operation denied, invalid arguments or total tick bound exceeded.
failure_modes.symptom: A recorded denial or error with no field change.
failure_modes.recovery: Check discovered documentation and use valid, bounded controls. Only experiment configuration grants availability.
